faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICGEB Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICGEB is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or an equivalent degree. Preference will be given to those who have cleared the DBT/CSIR JRF exam and have experience in anaerobic culturing and Omics analyses.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the ICGEB Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email with all required documents attached. Ensure you follow the instructions provided in the official notification for a successful submission.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at ICGEB will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at ICGEB is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the ICGEB located?
faq.answer: The International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Will I receive a salary for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates selected for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary as per the institute's norms.
